item.title: Yemen says death toll in Saudi attack on village near Sana’a reaches 40
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — The death toll from Saudi airstrikes on a village near Yemen’s capital has reached 40, with another 40 people wounded, according to the Health Ministry in Sana’a.
